grade: Crianças pequenas (4 anos a 5 anos e 11 meses)
subject: O eu, o outro e o nós
description_pt: Comunicar suas ideias e sentimentos a pessoas e grupos diversos.

components.description_pt: Expressar ideias pessoais claramente em discussões individuais, em grupo e lideradas pelo professor
components.description_en: Express personal ideas clearly in one-on-one, group, and teacher-led discussions
components.cc_component_description: Express personal ideas clearly in one-on-one, group, and teacher-led discussions

components.description_pt: Comunicar sentimentos apropriadamente para pares e adultos em contextos variados
components.description_en: Communicate feelings appropriately to peers and adults in varied contexts
components.cc_component_description: Communicate emotions and feelings constructively without generating conflict

components.description_pt: Adaptar comunicação de ideias e emoções para diferentes públicos
components.description_en: Adapt communication of ideas and emotions to different audiences
components.cc_component_description: Adapt writing purpose and approach for a range of tasks and audiences

cc_matches.description: Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 6 topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.
Write routinely over extended time frames (time for research, reflection, and revision) and shorter time frames (a single sitting or a day or two) for a range of tasks, purposes, and audiences.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar relatos para...
* describir problemas y situaciones del mundo real
* comunicar emociones y sentimientos sin generar conflicto
* desarrollar ideas y perspectivas de una variedad de orígenes y culturas, incluso de otros estudiantes bi/multilingües
* complementar historias con imágenes y representaciones para ampliar su significado
* resumir ideas presentadas durante un diálogo
* concluir a través de un cierre, un resumen y/o pasos a seguir
